inspiration.observed_pattern: One CTE computes grouped population statistics, a second CTE computes partitioned PERCENT_RANK values and conditional percentile aggregates, and the final query joins the summaries by their grouping key.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored team-score summary. Fixed player scores are ranked within each team, lower and upper percentile bands are aggregated in a second CTE, and a USING-style key join combines those values with team counts and averages; the source schema, metrics, labels, and analytics context are new.

fixture_notes: Team 11 has scores 10, 20, and 30, producing lower and upper band averages of 15 and 25. Team 22 has scores 5, 15, 25, and a tied 25, exercising peer-aware PERCENT_RANK values and averages of 10 and 25.
determinism_notes: Team IDs, player IDs, scores, rank ordering, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE score_teams (team_id INT PRIMARY KEY, team_label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE score_players (player_id INT PRIMARY KEY, team_id INT NOT NULL, score DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS player_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS average_score FROM score_players GROUP BY team_id), ranked_scores AS (SELECT team_id, score, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY score) AS score_percentile FROM score_players), team_percentiles AS (SELECT team_id, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN score_percentile <= 0.50 THEN score END), 2) AS lower_band_average, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN score_percentile >= 0.50 THEN score END), 2) AS upper_band_average FROM ranked_scores GROUP BY team_id) SELECT ts.team_id, ts.player_count, ts.average_score, tp.lower_band_average, tp.upper_band_average FROM team_stats AS ts JOIN team_percentiles AS tp USING (team_id) ORDER BY ts.team_id
